subject: Tobacco-Free Generation Proposal
overview: The Medford Board of Health heard a presentation on the Tobacco-Free Generation policy initiative aimed at phasing out tobacco and nicotine sales to younger generations. The Board also outlined upcoming topics for its January meeting.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the November 21 meeting.

items.title: Tobacco-Free Generation Presentation
items.summary: Received a presentation on the Tobacco-Free Generation initiative to restrict nicotine sales based on birth date, and discussed regional coordination and pending legal decisions.

items.title: New Business
items.summary: Planned to resume the tobacco discussion and review body art regulations at the January meeting.
